newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber okayed for wider Mississippi services.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber okayed for wider Mississippi services.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said on Thursday it had approval from the Mississippi Public Service Commission to offer a full range of local exchange telecommunications services in the state of Mississippi.
The company said that its Mississippi subsidiary will offer telecommunications services that can supplement or bypass those that businesses currently use.
It said it has installed a state-of-the-art central office switch for services in Jackson, Miss., and that local dial tone services will be available in early 1997.
Brooks Fiber is a full-service provider of local telecommunications services in medium-sized U.S. cities. It has 30 netowrks working or being built in 16 states.
